messages.content_html:
You start each game with 600 seconds to spend doing whatever you want. For example you could spend 60 seconds on your init/deck selection, then you have 540 seconds. Each turn you take consumes this time. Let's say you spend 1 second on your first time, now you have 539. If any player reaches 0 seconds left, they immediately lose the game on timeout.

Does that make sense? Happy to clarify further.
